view.scene_description: A modern, well-lit interior space resembling a bookstore or lounge with extensive bookshelves, seating areas, and large windows. People are seated at tables or standing near shelves. The ceiling features reflective panels and recessed lighting. A central spiral bookshelf adds architectural interest.

objects.label: bookshelves
objects.observation: Tall wooden shelves filled with books, extending from floor to ceiling on the left wall. Some sections have arched alcoves with small tables. Books are arranged neatly in rows, illuminated by warm lighting below shelves.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A cylindrical, multi-tiered bookshelf with glowing white rings, located centrally. It holds books on each level and is surrounded by seating. Reflective surfaces above it show distorted ceiling lights.

objects.label: seating area
objects.observation: Multiple orange chairs with metal legs arranged around small round tables. People are seated, some facing each other, others looking at books or screens. Chairs are positioned on polished floor tiles.

objects.label: people
objects.observation: Several individuals are present: one woman in a green jacket sits at a table, another person in white shirt sits beside her. Others are seen standing or seated further back near shelves. All appear engaged in reading or conversation.

objects.label: ceiling
objects.observation: High ceiling with recessed circular lights and dark structural beams. Reflective panels on the ceiling mirror the bookshelves and lights below, creating a layered visual effect.

objects.label: windows
objects.observation: Large glass windows on the right side of the room, showing reflections of the interior and possibly exterior structures. Blue-tinted glass enhances the modern aesthetic.

objects.label: tables
objects.observation: Small round tables with dark tops and metal legs, placed between chairs. One table has a person sitting at it, while others are empty or partially occupied.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000017", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
